# Evaluating Agents {#sec-agent-eval}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**Chapter status: skeleton.**
:::

**Learning objectives.** After this chapter you can:

- separate outcome evaluation from trajectory evaluation and use both;
- score tool use with precision, recall, step count, and cost;
- build scenario tests that catch regressions before users do;
- convert a production failure into a permanent regression test.

## Exercises

1. Take one agent failure from a real trace. Write the regression test that would have caught it.
2. Score the same 20 runs on outcome only and on trajectory. Find a run that passes one and fails the other.
